description: This file contains functions and types for parsing CSS selectors, including nested selectors, attribute selectors, and string parsing logic. It is part of the Playwright project, specifically for selector parsing utilities.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a structured ParsedSelector object, handling nested selectors and CSS parsing.

methods.name: splitSelectorByFrame
methods.description: Splits a selector string into multiple ParsedSelector objects based on 'enter-frame' control parts.

methods.name: stringifySelector
methods.description: Converts a ParsedSelector object or string back into a selector string, optionally forcing engine name inclusion.

methods.name: visitAllSelectorParts
methods.description: Traverses all parts of a ParsedSelector, applying a visitor function to each part.

methods.name: parseAttributeSelector
methods.description: Parses an attribute selector string into an AttributeSelector object, supporting various operators and value types.
